name: PitchBook
tagline: PitchBook is the leading data and research platform for the private equity, venture capital, and M&A markets. Its AI features include Morningstar quantitative equity ratings integrated with deal data, predictive fundraising signals, and natural language search across its database of 3 million+ companies.
